question: What are the names and ids of all makers with more than 2 models?
gold_query: SELECT T1.FullName , T1.Id FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*) > 2
